init_ascii = history[0].frame.ascii.split('\n')

def inner_5x5_compact(lines, rs, cs):

# Top sky blue patterns
s_targets = []
s_tile_pos = [(4,12), (4,35), (13,12), (13,35), (22,12), (22,35)]
for rs, cs in s_tile_pos:
    s_targets.append(inner_5x5_compact(init_ascii, rs, cs))

s_initial = [inner_5x5_compact(init_ascii, 40, 18 + i*7) for i in range(5)]

print("Initial sky blue bottom vs top:")
for i, s in enumerate(s_initial):
    matches = [j for j, t in enumerate(s_targets) if s == t]
    print(f"  Slot {i}: {s}")
    print(f"    Matches top tile: {matches}")

# Also check pink
p_targets = []
p_tile_pos = [(4,22), (4,45), (13,22), (13,45), (22,22), (22,45)]
for rs, cs in p_tile_pos:

    print(f"    Matches top tile: {matches}")
